title: The Weighing Scale
description: The number on the scale defines you today. Or does it? The mirror shows someone you're not sure you know.

choices.label: Skip meals, control what you can

outcomes.narration: You stop eating breakfast. Then lunch. The weight drops but so does everything else. Your grades slip. Your friends notice you seem pale.

choices.label: Run it off, every day, harder

outcomes.narration: You push yourself until your body aches. The endorphins help, but it's never enough. You're exhausted but still dissatisfied.

choices.label: Reject the scale's power over you

outcomes.narration: You put the scale away. You start eating to fuel your body instead of punish it. It's a long journey, but you feel stronger—inside and out.
